UPDATE reminders SET status = 'done' WHERE id = 1; SELECT length(facts) fl, rules IS NOT NULL r, length(kb) kl, length(subs) sl, reminders, followups FROM (SELECT (SELECT string_agg('[' || id || '] (' || category || ') ' || fact, E'
' ORDER BY category, id) FROM (SELECT * FROM agent_memory WHERE active ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 300) m) AS facts, (SELECT string_agg('- [' || id || '] ' || title || ': ' || coalesce(when_text,'') || ' => ' || coalesce(action_text,''), E'
' ORDER BY id) FROM work_playbook WHERE active) AS rules, (SELECT string_agg('## ' || title || E'
' || content, E'

' ORDER BY id) FROM knowledge_base WHERE section IN ('owner','how_to_use','finance','rules')) AS kb, (SELECT string_agg('[' || id || '] ' || name || ' | ' || kind || ' | status ' || status || ' | decision ' || decision || ' | next due ' || coalesce(to_char(next_due,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'?') || ' | cost ' || coalesce(cost::text || ' ' || currency,'?') || ' ' || coalesce(billing_cycle,'') || ' | why: ' || coalesce(purpose,'?') || ' | link: ' || coalesce(manage_url,'?'), E'
' ORDER BY id) FROM subscriptions WHERE status <> 'cancelled') AS subs, (SELECT string_agg('[' || id || '] ' || title || ' @ ' || to_char(due_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bahrain','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || CASE WHEN repeat_daily_until_done THEN ' (daily until done)' ELSE '' END, E'
' ORDER BY due_at) FROM reminders WHERE status = 'pending') AS reminders, (SELECT string_agg(x, E'
') FROM (SELECT '[reminder ' || id || '] ' || title || ' (sent ' || to_char(last_sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bahrain','MM-DD HH24:MI') || ')' AS x FROM reminders WHERE last_sent_at > now() - interval '3 days' AND status IN ('sent','pending') UNION ALL SELECT '[subscription ' || id || '] ' || name || ' due ' || to_char(next_due,'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' AND decision <> 'cancel' AND next_due IS NOT NULL AND next_due - remind_days_before <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bahrain')::date AND (snooze_until IS NULL OR snooze_until <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bahrain')::date)) f) AS followups) z
